**Finding: T4C — Compliant (sits at/above the fallback).**

- **Customer exit:** §14 (p0079) gives Client an unconditional election to terminate on written notice, with services running only to the last day of the month following notice — a convenience right on ≤~60 days, within the fallback's 60–90 day window.
- **No penalty:** No early-termination fee exists anywhere; §5 (p0045) bills monthly in arrears, so the three-months-of-fees cap is satisfied a fortiori.
- **Vendor side:** No mid-term convenience right. §13's cut-off of Sections 2–3 is a for-cause trigger (Client breach/default), and TrueLink's only other exit is 30 days' notice of intent not to renew at the end of the one-year term — a RENEWAL issue, not T4C, so it is not flagged twice.
- **Noted, not redlined:** notice can exceed 30 days depending on the month, and there is no express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees (limited impact given arrears invoicing). No redline proposed.
